description: This PHP source file defines an admin controller class for managing length classes in an OpenCart ecommerce platform. It includes methods for listing, creating, editing, and deleting length class entries, with appropriate permission checks, URL construction, and view rendering.

classes.name: LengthClass
classes.description: Controller class for managing length classes in the admin panel of OpenCart, including CRUD operations and list display.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Render the main length class management page with header, footer, and breadcrumbs.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Return the list of length classes, primarily by calling getList.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Retrieve and prepare the data for displaying a paginated list of length classes.

methods.name: form
methods.description: Display the form for creating or editing a length class, prefilled with existing data if editing.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handle saving a new or existing length class record, with validation and permission checks.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Delete selected length classes after checking user permissions and ensuring they are not default or associated with products.
